LanguageData.SSC_AphrodisiacEmitter.label: aphrodisiac emitter
LanguageData.SSC_AphrodisiacEmitter.description: Precisely controlled electrical energy keeps the PNA–humpshroom mixture in a semi-permanent mist-producing state, steadily releasing aphrodisiac mist.\nConsumes only electricity; no replenishment needed. Switched directly by the player, with an adjustable radius of 5–20 cells. Only affects targets in the same room.
